video_title: Lonzo and Gelo react to LaMelo trade to Timberwolves & talk parents divorce

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo and LiAngelo discuss LaMelo Ball's trade to the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: Melo got traded from the Hornets to the Timberwolves. Go Wolves.

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: Melo got traded from the Hornets to the Timberwolves.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball advocates for Draymond Green to join Golden State
quotes.excerpt: I am advocating Draymond go to Golden State.
quotes.quote: I am advocating Draymond go to Golden State.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball defends LaMelo Ball's trade to the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: People are questioning the fit. I think this is a great fit for him.
quotes.quote: I think this is a great fit for him. People are questioning the fit, but I think this is a great fit for him.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on LaMelo Ball and Anthony Edwards as teammates
quotes.excerpt: You have the two best players under 25 on the same team.
quotes.quote: You have the two best players under 25 on the same team.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball predicts Western Conference standings after potential roster moves
quotes.excerpt: If Draymond goes to Golden State and they manage to get Anthony Davis, they would jump for me to two, three.
quotes.quote: If Draymond goes to Golden State and they manage to get Anthony Davis, which is crazy, which I don't think is going to happen, but if that was to happen, they would jump for me to two, three. Minnesota would go four. Denver would be five. Houston six.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball calls the LaMelo Ball trade a win-win situation
quotes.excerpt: I think it was a win-win. They got Naz Reid, you can start Kobe, no problem.
quotes.quote: I think it was a win-win. They got Naz Reid, you can start Kobe, no problem. It is not that they are going to be, they are going to be good.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball believes LaMelo Ball is in a better situation
quotes.excerpt: I think Melo went to a better situation.
quotes.quote: I think Melo went to a better situation. They think they are better, cool, whatever, that is cool, and then I think Melo went to a better spot.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball addresses his parents' divorce and the media narrative
quotes.excerpt: The situation that is put before y'all is not how it went down.
quotes.quote: The situation that is put before y'all is not how it went down. I am not about to get in all the details, but long story short, my mom did not want to leave. She was forced to leave. I helped her leave. I am glad she left, she is in a great spot.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball clarifies the myth about his father's injury
quotes.excerpt: She did not leave him because he lost his foot, that is a myth that was put out there.
quotes.quote: She did not leave him because he lost his foot, that is a myth that was put out there. My dad did a great job raising us, my mom did a great job raising us. They did not work out, and it is what it is.
